_comment: Everything tunable about this project. Each node's "device" says which Pi it is meant to run on. It is the weakest identity source, not the authority: $PIHOME_DEVICE and /etc/pihome/device both override it, because they describe the machine. It is used when the Pi says nothing, and a disagreement is logged - see pihome.identity.assume().
